plugins/lampesoirmatinbe/desktop/php/lam.La position de votre installation n'est: The position of your installation is not set: sunrise and sunset times would be wrong. Set it in Settings → System → Configuration → General.

plugins/lampesoirmatinbe/desktop/php/lam.Le coucher du soleil varie de 16 h 30 en: Sunset ranges from 4:30 pm in December to 10:00 pm in June. A guard brings the moment back into the window: « not before 17:30 » fires at 17:30 on the evenings when the sun sets earlier. Leave empty to follow the sun all year.
plugins/lampesoirmatinbe/desktop/php/lam.Le moment où l'on veut de la lumière en: The moment you want light when coming home: most often a quarter of an hour before sunset.

plugins/lampesoirmatinbe/desktop/php/lam.Le moment où la lumière ne sert plus : a: The moment light is no longer needed: at sunrise, or at a fixed time to cut off after bedtime.
plugins/lampesoirmatinbe/desktop/php/lam.Onglet « Programmation » : réglez le soi: « Schedule » tab: set the evening and the morning, at a fixed time or relative to the sun.
plugins/lampesoirmatinbe/desktop/php/lam.Simulation de présence : le moment est a: Presence simulation: the moment is moved earlier or later at random, within this limit. The draw happens once a day, so the announced time is the one that will really be played.
